svg.aria-label: \begin{aligned} \varprojlim_{\mathbf{I}}D &\cong\mathbf{Set}\left(1,\varprojlim_{\mathbf{I}}D\right)\\ &\cong\{\text{cones on }D\text{ with vertex }1\}\\ &\cong\Bigl\{(x_I)_{I\in\mathbf{I}}\ \Big|\ x_I\in D(I)\text{ for all }I\in\mathbf{I}\text{ and }(Du)(x_I)=x_J\\ &\hspace{5em}\text{for all }I\xrightarrow{u}J\text{ in }\mathbf{I}\Bigr\}, \end{aligned}\tag{5.16}
